edges.fact: City View Rooftop offers a Corporate Team Building Package for corporate groups, including a 2-hour private rooftop rental and a complimentary drink ticket per guest, accommodating up to 20 people, starting at $500 for a weekday afternoon event.
The Corporate Team Building Package includes a selection of outdoor games such as Giant Jenga.
City View Rooftop has a variety of outdoor games, including Giant Jenga and Ring Toss, and can accommodate groups of up to 20 people.
Samantha is the events manager at City View Rooftop who helps with corporate bookings.
